#nonpaid #nonuion

 **CASTING CALL — GROOSE | THE LEGEND OF ZELDA: SKYWARD SWORD**

Are you a **Legend of Zelda fan** interested in voice acting? I’m looking for a voice actor to portray **Groose** in a fan-made *The Legend of Zelda: Skyward Sword* project!

 **ABOUT GROOSE:**

Groose is loud, confident, competitive, and often acts like he’s the toughest guy in Skyloft. Beneath his boastful personality, he has a good heart and genuinely cares about those around him.

**AUDITION INSTRUCTIONS:**

Audition lines will be provided specifically for the character you are auditioning for.

When recording:

• **No slate is necessary.** Begin directly with the audition lines.
• **Stick strictly to the provided lines.**
• **No improvisation.** Do not add or change dialogue.
• **No intention repeats.** Each line should only be performed once.
• Please submit **one complete audio file** containing your entire audition.

Accepted formats: **MP3 or WAV**.
• **Do not send multiple audio attachments.** Your audition must be contained in **one single MP3 or WAV file**.
• Failure to follow these submission requirements will result in the audition being **rejected**.

📅 **AUDITION DEADLINE**

**October 13, 2026**

📩 **SUBMIT YOUR AUDITION**

Send your completed audition as **one MP3 or WAV attachment** to:

**[linkhyrule776@yahoo.ca](mailto:linkhyrule776@yahoo.ca)**

 **PROJECT PRIVACY**

This is a **fan-made project created by fans, for fans.**

To keep the project private during production, **my YouTube channel will not be revealed during casting.**

If you are selected for the role, my YouTube channel and additional project information will be revealed **after production and once you have been chosen for the role.**

Groose's Lines: 
* **On Life Advice:** "My advice? Work hard and wish with all your heart. You might even come in second." 

* **On His Iconic Hairstyle:** "You lay off the do right now, or I'll flatten you. Everyone knows I've got the slickest pompadour in town.

* **On Renaming the Surface World:** "This place needs a name. Yeah... A name fitting for this rugged, adventurous wilderness. From now on, we'll call it... Grooseland!" 

* **On Bullying Link Early On:** "Oh, wait... I got it. You're here to talk about today's race. I can see it in those dopey eyes of yours. They're pleading, 'Oh, Groose, can you please find it in your heart to let me win today? Please!'" 

* **On Dragging the Academy's Name:** "Would you wake up, straighten up, and grow a backbone already? Dopes like you are dragging our honored academy through the mud." 

* **On Stealing Link's Crimson Loftwing:** "Course it was. You thought a big Crimson Loftwing like that was gonna go down without a fight? But we got him... He's not getting out of that pen anytime soon, boys." 
* 
* **On His Redemption and Guarding the Sealed Grounds:** "Nah, don't worry about me. I'm gonna hang back here, Link... Someone's gotta stick around and guard the place. Might as well be me. Besides, if I'm not here, who's gonna look out for the old girl?" 

* **On Rebranding the Entire Game:** "Nice going, you two. You guys were totally amazing in this little adventure I like to call the Legend of Groose. ... That's a little joke."

**CASTING CALL | COUPLES | SUNSHINE COAST, BC**

I’m looking for **two couples** who would love to spend 2–3 nights at a beautiful private oceanfront property on the Sunshine Coast and be part of a television filming and lifestyle content shoot.

Villa Sol in Halfmoon Bay is being featured in a Canadian travel television series on **Tuesday, September 29**, and we’re looking for couples who are natural and comfortable in front of the camera to help bring the experience of the property to life.

**The exchange:**

A complimentary 2–3 night stay at Villa Sol in exchange for participating in the filming and lifestyle content. There is no additional monetary compensation. **Transportation/ferry costs and meals are not included.**

During the filming, you may be captured experiencing different parts of the property — sauna, hot tub, oceanfront, decks, fireside spaces, yoga/sound and other lifestyle moments — as well as some additional Villa Sol photography and video during the stay.

**We’re looking for couples who:**

• Are available September 29 and flexible to be on standby throughout the filming day

• Are comfortable being photographed and filmed, both individually and together

• Feel natural and relaxed on camera

• Are comfortable signing appropriate photo/video releases

• Are happy participating in lifestyle and wellness experiences around the property

• Ideally have an active social media presence and enjoy sharing travel, wellness, nature or lifestyle experiences with their community

The right fit for us is less about traditional modelling experience and more about finding people who genuinely fit the Villa Sol experience and will be comfortable having a fun, relaxed few days while we capture it.

**Interested? Please DM me with:**

• Both of your names and ages

• A recent photo together

• Your social media handles

• Where you’ll be travelling from

• Confirmation that you’re both available September 29

• A little about yourselves and why the experience appeals to you

I’ll be choosing two couples based on overall fit for the property and filming.

Villa Sol is located in **Halfmoon Bay on BC’s Sunshine Coast** and requires ferry travel for those coming from the Vancouver area. 

Please visit [www.solunastays.ca](https://www.solunastays.ca/) to get a sense of the property.

items.text:
A Fake Prop Deserves a Real Safety Conversation
A casting notice asking a child to hold a fake knife may sound simple. For a young performer, however, it introduces questions that deserve answers before the family agrees.

Who controls the prop? When will the child first see and handle it? Is it rubber, blunted, retractable, or another purpose-built substitute? What movement will the scene require? Will anyone approach the child while the prop is in their hand?

Industry safety guidance says edged and piercing props should be controlled by a qualified responsible person, inspected, explained to performers, and addressed in a safety meeting. Productions should allow enough time for training and rehearsal, and no performer should be pressured into handling one.

SAG-AFTRA’s guidance for young performers is equally clear: parents and minors may refuse activity that seems physically or emotionally questionable. A child who feels afraid cannot simply be told that the prop is harmless and expected to continue.

Before saying yes, ask for:

A plain-language description of the action and finished scene
The prop’s material and safety features
The name or role of the person responsible for it
A rehearsal before cameras roll
Clear rules about who may touch the prop
An agreed word or signal that stops the action immediately
Confirmation that the child may change their mind without pressure
A fake weapon can help tell a fictional story. The safety plan around it must be completely real.

Sources: SAG-AFTRA Young Performer Safety Tips and Industry Safety Bulletin #30

items.text:
🎞️ SUNIL BABBAR TALES
(Reflections on Indian Cinema)

🎬 KHILONA--When the “Khilona” Became the Heart of the Story...

There are films that we remember for their stars.

And then there are films we remember because one character stays with us long after the story is over.

For me, "Khilona" (1970) belongs to the second category.

Directed by Chander Vohra, produced by L. V. Prasad, and written by Gulshan Nanda, "Khilona" brought together Sanjeev Kumar, Mumtaz, Jeetendra, Shatrughan Sinha, Durga Khote and a wonderful supporting cast. Its music was composed by Laxmikant–Pyarelal, with lyrics by Anand Bakshi.

The story is unusual.

Vijaykamal Singh, played by Sanjeev Kumar, is psychologically shattered after a traumatic experience. His family believes that marriage might help bring him back to normal life.

And then comes 'Chand', played by Mumtaz- a courtesan who agrees to enter the family as his supposed wife.

What begins as an arrangement gradually becomes something much deeper.

Because Chand is initially treated as though she has no dignity, no place and no identity beyond the role she has been asked to perform.

But slowly, through her patience, compassion and emotional strength, she becomes the person who holds the family together.

And that is where "Khilona" becomes more than a conventional Hindi melodrama.

Mumtaz changes the meaning of the title.

'Chand' is called a “Khilona”-a plaything.

But the film gradually turns that idea upside down.

The woman whom society considers disposable becomes the person with the greatest emotional strength.

That is a wonderful piece of screenwriting.

And Mumtaz understood it beautifully.

Her performance earned her the Filmfare Award for Best Actress, while "Khilona" won Best Film at the 18th Filmfare Awards. Sanjeev Kumar was also nominated for Best Actor.

And then there is the music.

“Khilona Jaan Kar Tum To Mera Dil Tod Jaate Ho”, sung by Mohammed Rafi, remains one of the unforgettable songs associated with the film. The soundtrack also brought together Lata Mangeshkar, Kishore Kumar, Asha Bhosle and Manna Dey under the musical direction of Laxmikant–Pyarelal.

As a filmmaker, what I take away from "Khilona" is simple:

Never underestimate the emotional power of a character just because society within the story underestimates that character.

Sometimes the person standing at the edge of the story is actually carrying its heart.

And perhaps that is why "Khilona" deserves to be rediscovered.

🎥 If you haven't watched "Khilona", please search for it online and watch the film.

Don't watch it merely as an old Hindi movie.

Watch it to understand how story, performance, music and emotion came together in an era when character-driven cinema could reach a massive audience.

Good films deserve to be watched.

Good filmmakers deserve to be remembered.

And sometimes, the best way to preserve Indian cinema is simply to watch it again.

— Sunil Babbar
Filmmaker | Actor | Director

A feature film based on the true story behind the bestselling book Bad Karma: The True Story of a Mexico Trip from Hell by Paul Wilson.

In the summer of 1978, three surfers from San Diego set out on a roadtrip through Mexico and find themselves pulled into an unforgettable journey of danger, survival, friendship, and the kind of story that feels too wild to be true.

Production begins September 2026.

items.text:
**CREW CALL!**

***LA-BASED INDIE PRODUCERS & EAST COAST BASED CREW—THIS ONE IS FOR YOU!***

*Head Down, Chin Up*©* *is a **proof of concept short film **for a feature script written by Ella McKenzie & Mark Stafford. The short film proof of concept is to be directed by DGA Student Film award-winning director Ella McKenzie, and is being produced by herself, Juliet Bornholdt, and Isha Kamdar (**all based in Los Angeles, CA)**. (@headdownchinupmovie on Instagram) 

**LOGLINE: **Isolated by severe anxiety, a 13-year-old sketch artist becomes fascinated by bizarre backyard junk piles — and the eccentric widower creating them.

**COMPS: **JUNO, LADY BIRD, AFTERSUN, I SAW THE TV GLOW, LITTLE MISS SUNSHINE

View the Pitch Deck!: [https://canva.link/headdownchinupmovie](https://canva.link/headdownchinupmovie) 

**WHERE: **Aiming to shoot in Plymouth, Barnstable, or Bristol County, Massachusetts where director has family connections. HOWEVER, the creative team is open to Southern California (where we're based) if we find the right location that *feels *enough like New England fall. TBD. 

**There are budget line items to fly out 1 addl. producer, the DP, the AD, & the PD. All other crew will be locally sourced.*

**WHEN: **Aiming to secure complete ~$30k budget through crowdfunding by 11/25/26, and begin shooting the following week. Generally, the creative team is aiming to shooting in late Fall / early Winter (before it gets too cold). Spring 2027 can be made possible as needed. Goal is a 3-day shoot with Zoom meetings leading up to production. 

**ISO: ****female-identifying & queer folk highly encouraged to apply!**

***Note:**** Meals, copy, and credit included for all. Compensation otherwise varies by role, as noted. Compensation is based on our GOAL BUDGET RAISED and a successful crowdfunding campaign. We appreciate your understanding that this is an indie passion project powered by young filmmakers.*
* **Producers:** **Unpaid*. We are seeking other young filmmakers/producers who are seeking to join a highly motivated and FUN LA-based team to build their filmmaking portfolios. Ideally, these filmmakers connect with the story, have roots & connections in the indie film community, and are **motivated to join us and speak for the project in their networks to promote our Seed&Spark fundraising campaign**. **Producers with connections to indie film investors are a PLUS!** Writer/director loves using producers as a creative bounce-board, so having similar taste is also a plus! This is generally great crowdfunding experience!! ***NOTE: We have budgeted for one additional producer to be flown out to production -- if we shoot on the East Coast.***
* **Casting Director: **$1500 flat rate to cast (2) roles. IMPORTANT: we want to cast a name actor for WYMAN (Male, 70s-80s) and have budgeted $4k to pay him. Goal names include Christopher Walken, JK Simmons, Michalel McKean, etc. We'd love to find a CD with connections to this caliber of talent.   
* **Animation Sketch Artist: **$2000 flat rate to create handful of original, hand-drawn sketches that play a central role ON SCREEN in the short film. To be drawn in the style of the 13-year-old protagonist. In post, these sketches will be ANIMATED on screen as well. Can be based anywhere, but LA is a plus. Rate negotiable.
* **Director of Photography** **who owns their own camera: *$1000 flat, 3 shoot days + prep. Kit fee negotiable. Ideally LA-based so we can meet in person! The ideal DP has experience on similar projects and a reel. 
* **Assistant Director: **$250/day, 3 shoot days + prep. Ideally LA-based so we can meet in person before production! The ideal AD has plenty of experience. 
* **Production Designer: **$1000 flat. 3 shoot days + significant prep -- the "junk piles" are a huge part of this production. Ideally LA-based so we can meet in person before production! Local hire for South Shore, Massachusetts production -- no travel budgeted.
* **Sound Mixer: **$250/day, 3 shoot days. A sound kit fee is budgeted, but if you own one, that's a plus! 
* **Costume Designer: **$250/day, 3 shoot days. Local hire for South Shore, Massachusetts production -- no travel budgeted. Costumes budget is low -- actors will likely bring their own clothes. 
* **Gaffer: **$250/day, 3 shoot days. Local hire for South Shore, Massachusetts production -- no travel budgeted.
* **Grips (2):** $200/day, 3 shoot days. Great for students! Local hire for South Shore, Massachusetts production -- no travel budgeted.
* **ACs (2): **$200/day, 3 shoot days. Great for students! Local hire for South Shore, Massachusetts production -- no travel budgeted.
* **PAs (2): **$150/day, 3 shoot days. Great for students! Local hire for South Shore, Massachusetts production -- no travel budgeted

Please fill out the below form to tell us a bit about yourself and indicate which role(s) you are interested in!

https://forms.gle/REnmXS1Y59eSYNLz6

**ĆWICZENIA Z WOLNOŚCI. **Z przyjemnością i ekscytacją zapraszam na moje pierwsze w Polsce roczne warsztaty treningowo-kreatywne dla osób aktorskich i performerskich zainteresowanych eksploracją warsztatu i własnego języka twórczego.

Trening poprowadzi nas przez cztery etapy inspirowane podziałem Teatru Reduty — Zabawę, Przeżywanie, Przeistoczenie i Obrzędowość, a moduł eksploracji indywidualnej poetyki będzie oparty na zadaniach kreatywnych autorstwa hiszpańskiego twórcy Carlosa Tuñóna.

Chciałbym przede wszystkich dotrzeć do osób, które mają potrzebę rozwijać swój język twórczy i być inicjatorami autorskich projektów.

Pełna informacja: [https://tomaszborczyk.pl/project/cwiczenia-z-wolnosci-warsztaty-roczne-2026-2027/](https://tomaszborczyk.pl/project/cwiczenia-z-wolnosci-warsztaty-roczne-2026-2027/)

📅 Start: 8 października 2026, czwartki 10:00–15:00
📍 Warszawa
💰 600 zł/miesiąc
👥 12 miejsc

Termin zgłoszeń: 30 września 2026

Prowadzi: Tomasz Borczyk (RESAD Madryt, dyrektor artystyczny kolektywu Noche de Camaleones, obecnie współpracuje z Instytutem Grotowskiego i Komuną Warszawa)

Do reklamy obiektu rekreacyjnego na **Jurze Krakowsko-Częstochowskiej** poszukujemy **6 osób** do udziału w nagraniu:

**3 kobiety i 3 mężczyzn**
**Wiek:** ok. 35–45/50 lat

Szukamy osób fotogenicznych, naturalnych i swobodnie czujących się przed kamerą.

Nagranie będzie miało charakter lifestyle’owo-biznesowy. Do odegrania będzie kilka prostych scen, bez wypowiedzi, m.in.: **spotkanie biznesowe w obiekcie, wspólne spędzanie wolnego czasu, korzystanie z atrakcji obiektu oraz wycieczka po Jurze Krakowsko-Częstochowskiej.**

**Termin:** 28.09.2026
**Miejsce:** Podlesice, woj. śląskie
**Godziny:** do ustalenia
**Wynagrodzenie:** 500 zł netto / osoba / dzień zdjęciowy

Prawdopodobnie potrzebne będą własne stylizacje – zarówno w charakterze biznesowym, jak i bardziej casualowym. Szczegóły ustalimy przed nagraniem.

**Zgłoszenia:**
Prosimy o przesłanie aktualnych zdjęć, krótkiego filmiku oraz kilku słów o sobie na adres: **[praca@goodeye.com.pl](mailto:praca@goodeye.com.pl)**

W tytule wiadomości prosimy wpisać: **„Casting biznes”**.

Zastrzegamy sobie kontakt z wybranymi osobami.

Do reklamy obiektu rekreacyjnego na **Jurze Krakowsko-Częstochowskiej** poszukujemy osób do udziału w nagraniu, w szczególności **rodziny 2+2**:

**Mama i tata:** 30–35 lat
**Dziewczynka i chłopiec:** 5–7 lat

Szukamy osób fotogenicznych, naturalnych i swobodnie czujących się przed kamerą.

Nagranie będzie miało charakter lifestyle’owy. Do odegrania będzie kilka prostych scen, bez wypowiedzi, przedstawiających rodzinny pobyt w obiekcie, m.in.: meldowanie się w hotelu, wspólny obiad, SPA, siłownia, basen i sauna, piesza wycieczka po okolicy.

**Termin:** 29.09.2026
**Miejsce:** Podlesice, woj. śląskie
**Godziny:** do ustalenia
**Wynagrodzenie:** 500 zł netto / osoba / dzień zdjęciowy

Prawdopodobnie potrzebne będą własne stylizacje – szczegóły ustalimy przed nagraniem.

**Zgłoszenia:**
Prosimy o przesłanie aktualnych zdjęć, krótkiego filmiku oraz kilku słów o sobie/rodzinie na adres: **[praca@goodeye.com.pl](mailto:praca@goodeye.com.pl)**

W tytule wiadomości prosimy wpisać: **„Rodzina 2+2”**.

Zastrzegamy sobie kontakt z wybranymi osobami.

Bright Star Touring Theatre, the nation’s largest provider of theatre for youth audiences, is currently seeking an Indigenous actor for our 2-person national tour. We are accepting performers of all gender identities for a tour that includes the shows: “Peter Pan”, “Cherokee Tales”, and “The Pirate of Bully Bay”.

This is a paid opportunity, including a compensated rehearsal period, with travel and lodging provided for the duration of the contract. Rehearsal begins in Raleigh, NC on October 4th, and the tour runs through November 24th. Compensation is set at $500/week, including the lodging and tour vehicle.

Applicants should have professional theatre training and experience (a theatre degree is preferable), a valid driver's license, as well as a clean driving and criminal record. We are currently only accepting applicants who are 21 or older. We are looking for strong character actors who are self motivated, independent, and want to travel to exciting, new places!

Please submit your headshot, resume, and availability to hunter@brightstartheatre.com to be considered. We will be conducting virtual auditions on an ongoing basis.

Casting non-union indie short! 🎬
Hi all! I’m helping to produce a low-budget short film and we are accepting auditions into next week! If interested, please DM me with your email address and I will send you self-tape instructions. Thanks! 

—————————

PROJECT TITLE: Three Days with Stevie
UNION STATUS: Non-Union
COMPENSATION: Paid (rate negotiable)
SHOOT DATES: Early November 2026 based on actor availability 
LOCATION: Los Angeles, CA (locals only) 

Tensions flare as two strangers awaiting new identities are forced to share a safe house. 

Three Days with Stevie is a character-driven crime drama with dark comedic undertones. Confined to a single location, the story hinges entirely on the push-and-pull between two mismatched personalities running out of patience — and time. This is a dialogue-heavy, performance-driven script; we're looking for actors who can hold a scene with nuance, timing, and tension.

ROLES:

CALVIN — Man; 22 to 30 years old; all ethnicities. A smart-mouthed kid who's in way over his head. Calvin talks a big game to cover the fact that he has no idea what he's doing. Naive but quick-witted, he uses sarcasm as armor— until reality catches up with him. Great role for an actor who can flip between comic timing and real vulnerability.

STEVIE — Man; 35 to 45 years old; all ethnicities. Cold, stoic, and a man of few words, Stevie is a hardened criminal whose silence carries more weight than anything he says. Beneath the surface, he's haunted by the weight of past deeds he's never made peace with. 🩸 Please note: this role involves makeup/blood FX.

CASTING CALL- PLEASE READ CAREFULLY- NO DM'S WILL BE CONSIDERED. NON-UNION.

**HOW TO SUBMIT:**
Please fill out the following form, further information about shoot dates and rates are noted at the top of the form. NO emailed or DM submissions will be considered. 

[https://forms.gle/GDr9f83ZdqAiDNvr6](https://forms.gle/GDr9f83ZdqAiDNvr6)

Details: 

We are casting **Three (3) hero roles plus office background talent** for a commercial campaign filming in the Toronto/GTA.

All hero roles are non-speaking and performance-driven. We are looking for natural, contemporary professionals who feel authentic in a premium corporate office environment.

Talent should have strong screen presence and be comfortable with subtle, natural performance. We are looking for real, believable reactions and behaviour rather than overly expressive commercial acting.

All ethnicities encouraged.

**HERO CLIENT**

**Gender:** Male
**Playing Age:** 30-45
**Role:** Principal/Hero

A confident, contemporary business professional arriving for an important meeting. Polished and credible, but approachable and natural. Strong screen presence with the ability to communicate subtle reactions through expression and body language.

**Gender:** Female
**Playing Age:** 30-45
**Role:** Principal/Hero

A sophisticated, perceptive professional touring a potential new office space. Confident and self-assured, with strong screen presence. The performance is subtle and observational, with much of the character's impression communicated through small reactions and body language.

**Gender:** Female
**Playing Age:** 30-45
**Role:** Principal/Hero

A polished, warm and confident commercial leasing professional leading a prospective tenant through an office tour. Professional and composed while still feeling approachable, natural and authentic.

**OFFICE BACKGROUND TALENT**

🎬 CASTING-AUFRUF: Vater & Kind-Rolle für Kurzfilm „05:05“ 🎬
Für das experimentelle Kurzfilm-Drama „05:05“ (Regie & Produktion: Ewald Kiricenko / HdM Stuttgart) suchen wir die Besetzung für zwei wichtige Rollen.  

(Hinweis: Die Hauptrolle des 19-jährigen Eren ist bereits besetzt!)  

📌 Projekt-Details:

 Titel: 05:05  

 Format: Experimenteller Kurzfilm (Drama / Social Study)  

 Ausstrahlung: Filmfestivals, MUBI, YouTube  
 Regie & Produktion: Ewald Kiricenko  

 Kontakt / Bewerbung: ewald.kiricenko@gmail.com | Tel.: 0176 21462320  

📖 Logline:
Ein 19-Jähriger hat bis Mitternacht Zeit, sich für eine sichere Zukunft zu bewerben. Doch während sein Vater, Social Media und eine zunehmend vertraute KI ihm erklären, was aus ihm werden soll, muss er entscheiden, ob er sein Leben auf eine Zukunft ausrichten kann, an die er selbst nicht glaubt.  

🎭 Gesuchte Rollen:

1. ONUR / VATER (männlich)

 Spielalter: ca. 45–55 Jahre (Figur ist 47 Jahre alt)  
 Rollenprofil: Erens pragmatischer Vater. Er meint es grundsätzlich gut und sorgt sich ehrlich um die finanzielle Zukunft seines Sohnes („etwas Sicheres/Vernünftiges lernen“), versteht jedoch Erens Wunsch nach einer künstlerischen Laufbahn nicht.  

 Anforderungen: Starke Präsenz, Überzeugungskraft, authentisches Zusammenspiel in emotional geladenen Dialogszenen (Konflikt zwischen elterlicher Fürsorge, Pragmatismus und Unverständnis).  

2. KIND EREN (männlich)

 Spielalter: ca. 9–12 Jahre (Figur in der Rückblende ist ca. 11 Jahre alt)  

 Rollenprofil: Eren als Kind in Rückblenden / Erinnerungsszenen. Ein aufgeweckter, unbeschwerter Junge mit einer natürlichen Begeisterung für das Zeichnen.  

 Anforderungen: Authentisches, pures Kinderlächeln, Freude am Malen/Zeichnen. Kompakter Drehaufwand.  

📩 Bewerbung:

Bitte sendet eure Bewerbung mit dem Betreff „Casting 05:05 – [Rolle: Vater OR Kind Eren]“ an:
📧 ewald.kiricenko@gmail.com

Inhalt der Bewerbung:

 Für die Vater-Rolle: Aktuelle Fotos (Porträt & Ganzkörper), Wohnort, Kontaktdaten sowie Showreel / Arbeitsproben (falls vorhanden).

 Für die Kind-Rolle (durch Erziehungsberechtigte): Name & Alter des Kindes, 2–3 aktuelle Fotos, Wohnort & Kontaktdaten der Eltern.

📄 Weitere Infos zum Visuellen Stil und zur Stimmungs-Welt findet ihr im Pitchdeck hier: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1YSoMOpidVeFM0DwhE_ZnwZwzE-Wa8usT/view?usp=drivesdk

Wir freuen uns sehr auf eure Einsendungen! 🎥✨

Für den Kurzfilm "AT : Es stand Alles im Wahlprogramm"
sind folgende Rollen zu besetzen 

- Arabisch /Türkischer Mann ca. 20 Jahre alt
-Arabisch / Türkischer Mann ca 50 - 60 Jahre alt
- Deutscher Mann ca. 27 Jahre alt
-Arabisch / Türkische Frau ca. 27 Jahre alt
- Deutscher Mann ca 45 Jahre alt

Ein rechtradikaler Politiker sonnt sich nach einer Wahl  in seinem Erfolg.
Aber die Fassade bröckelt. Eine bittere  Politsatire. 

Aufgrund des aktuellen Bezuges sollte der Dreh schnell erfolgen, daher kann jeder Schauspieler seine Rolle am Laptop oder Smartphone selber Filmen. 
Der Film soll dann kostenfrei auf you Tube gestellt werden und jeder kann den Film sofort nutzen. Es geht darum den Film zu verbreiten, daher auch leider keine Bezahlung,  da kein Geld verdient werden kann. 
Ich hoffe es finden sich Schauspieler, die sich gegen den Rechtsradikalismus stellen und Charakter zeigen.

Ich bin Thomas Goersch,  Schauspieler und Filmregisseur www.imdb.com/name/nm1591928

Bis dann
Thomas

Casting : "Maybe its love, Maybe not"
Wanted !!!!!
I am Thomas Goersch from Stuttgart, Germany. 
Actor and Filmdirector. 
I am a director of Independent Movies.
I present my movies on International Film festivals and was lucky to receive some awards. 
But the work is not about awards and money, its about making movies for the people to think about.
My next movie is a modern love story:
An elderly man is meeting another younger, very attractive man in the Internet. But they are from different Continents. They start a long distance relastionship ship. which is full of passion and desire. 
One day the younger man starts to ask for money, cause he is a Student and no more able to pay his bills. 
The older man is full of distrust.
Is he only there to pay his lovers bills or is there love between them ?
A story with two endings.
One with true love and one with only cheating. Based on a real story.
I am looking for the young attraktive Lover.
Men 25 to 36 years old, good looking who is able to film his parts on his own by smartshone
I am always open and honest. You can earn no money on this. but maybe there is a good film in the end promoting for you.
Thats me 
www.imdb.com/name/nm1591928
Get in touch under Thomas.Goersch@vodafonemail.de 
please ask for details.

Dans le cadre du développement de notre studio, nous recherchons des personnes à l’aise devant l’objectif pour participer à différents shootings photo et tournages vidéo.

Logline: After one musician hits the other with his car, the two of them are forced to confront their hatred for one another on the biggest night of their career. 

Roles:** *****Please note that piano skills/knowledge are **NOT** required for **ANY** of the roles. 

MATTHEW - **LEAD** - Male, 20 - 30 years old (5 days of filming)

Description on casting call 

ELIOT - **LEAD** - Male, 20 - 30 years old (4 days of filming) 

Description on casting call 

COORDINATOR - **SUPPORTING** - 40+ years old (1 day of filming) 

Instructor overseeing the showcase. 

KENT - **SUPPORTING** - 20 -30 years old (1 day of filming)

Fellow competing Pianist and classmate.

ROBIN - **SUPPORTING** - 20 - 30 years old (1 day of filming) 

Fellow competing Pianist and classmate. 

CROWD - **BACKGROUND** - All genders, 18+ years old (1 day of filming)

Acting as a crowd in attendance for a competitive piano showcase.

Director: **Evan McKercher**

Producer: **Kayla Larson** 

Production Type: **Short Film**

Contact Information: **kayllarson17@gmail.com**

Run Time: **10-12 minutes**

Compensation: **Unpaid - Will provide addendum stating reel will be provided for each actor within a timely manner + crafty & catering will be provided **

Union Status: **Non-Union but can be SAG eligible upon request **

Auditions: Sides are available via the **QR code** at the bottom of the casting call. Please email self-tapes to **kayllarson17@gmail.com**

Shooting Schedule: **October 16, 17, 18 & 30** (with a pick up day scheduled for November, but only for Matthew)

Filming Location: **Denver, CO + 1 day in Erie, CO (only for Mathew & Eliot)**

CASTING CALL | PAID PHOTOSHOOT | COLORADO SPRINGS

Axis is casting grandparents and teens/young adults for a lifestyle photoshoot celebrating the relationship between grandparents and their grandchildren.

Date: Thursday, September 24
Location: Colorado Springs, CO
Time: Approximately 2-hour windows
Pay: $200 flat rate per person
PHOTOSHOOT ONLY. No video or dialogue.

Seeking:
• Grandmas & Grandpas, ages 60–75
• Teens/young adults, ages 14–20
• A variety of ethnicities and family backgrounds

Photos will feature natural moments like baking together, playing games, reading the Bible, playing chess, celebrating a graduation, cheering at a football game, and working on a car.

Real grandparents and grandchildren are encouraged to submit together, but you do not need to be related. No professional experience required.

To submit: Email irene@axis.org with your name, age, current photo/headshot, phone number, and availability on September 24. If submitting together, please include information and photos for each person.

topComments.text: Hi I would love to!

𝐂𝐀𝐒𝐓𝐈𝐍𝐆 & 𝐂𝐑𝐄𝐖 𝐂𝐀𝐋𝐋

Hey there, our lovely industry! I’m entering the second phase of Pre-Production and I’m still needing some help for our Thriller Short Indie Film, Cartyr!
𝙈𝙤𝙧𝙚 𝙨𝙤 𝙤𝙣 𝙩𝙝𝙚 𝙘𝙧𝙚𝙬 𝙨𝙞𝙙𝙚 <—
𝙗𝙪𝙩 𝙤𝙥𝙚𝙣 𝙨𝙥𝙤𝙩𝙨 𝙛𝙤𝙧 𝙘𝙖𝙨𝙩

Logline: After being convicted and sent to a psychiatric institution, a mass-murdering serial killer is brought in for another mandated therapy session with his doctor—but this time, something is different.

ᴀʙᴏᴜᴛ ᴛʜᴇ ᴘʀᴏᴊᴇᴄᴛ
Production Type: Independent Short Film
Genre: Horror / Thriller
Runtime: Approximately 10 minutes
Filming Window: The 2nd-3rd Week of October.
Location: Colorado Springs, CO.

This is currently an unpaid independent project. Food will be provided during filming, and all cast and crew will receive full film credits and IMDb credit.

The production is expected to require 2–3 days of filming, with the majority of scenes taking place indoors.

𝐂𝐀𝐒𝐓𝐈𝐍𝐆 𝐂𝐀𝐋𝐋 
Young Cartyr
Age: 8-14
Physical Description:
- Brown Hair
- Hazel eyes hopefully but Green/Brown Eyes work too. 
- Mixed Hispanic/Caucasian.
Role: Supporting
I need a young performer who fits a younger version of me. He must appear hollow, falsely empathetic, cold but not fully unnerving yet at this time in his life. Must be careful with loud performances and things being thrown about.

The Victims
Age: Late 20s–mid 30s
Number Needed: 3
Role: Background / Supporting
Three performers needed to loom over the scene and, through body language and physical presence, showing that they silently despise what they see in front of them.
(Must be comfortable with SFX wounds and makeup.)

Extras
Age: Late 20s–mid 30s
Role: Background
Various victims who will appear briefly throughout intense scenes.
(Must be comfortable with SFX wounds and makeup.)

𝐂𝐑𝐄𝐖 𝐂𝐀𝐋𝐋
Producer: A producer would be nice to help with logistics, scheduling and such. It’s been a headache to handle with just myself and my co-owner! Those also potentially helping fund small things would be nice but not required.

1st AD: I will also be acting in the film, so I would greatly appreciate someone who can help keep production moving.

Boom Op/Sound Engineer: Probably the biggest things right now. Someone with experience or the equipment to spare!
But background in recording audio and working with post-production sound would be greatly appreciated. Or help with sound in general!

(A shotgun microphone and/or boom setup would also be extremely helpful.)

Editor: 
An editor is not absolutely required at this stage, but if I can find an editor for post-production, it would be DEEPLY appreciated and would help take some pressure off me.

𝑳𝑶𝑪𝑨𝑻𝑰𝑶𝑵𝑺
There is a scene set in a closed doctors office. A mental institution. A closed space would do nicely or if anyone has an actual space we can use that fits it, minus the windows, doctors office, chairs, desk, whatever! It’ll would be helpful. Thank you! 

𝑪𝑶𝑵𝑻𝑨𝑪𝑻 𝑰𝑵𝑭𝑶𝑹𝑴𝑨𝑻𝑰𝑶𝑵
If you’re interested in a cast or crew position, or simply want to help with the project in any capacity, feel free to comment, message, or (preferably) email:
morelandcreativearts@gmail.com

For Cast Applicants,
If you’re interested in a casting role, please submit your headshot, reel, and resume if you have them.

This film shall either be set on a weekend of the 2nd or 3rd week October. This casting call is currently for pre-production and early recruitment purposes.

Thank you for your help!

🎭 NOT ALL ACTING TRAINING WILL GET YOU CLOSER TO BOOKING WORK.
And you might not even realise it.

If you’ve been taking acting classes for months or even years, but you’re still struggling with your confidence, technique or ability to apply what you’re learning…

Your teacher might not be the right teacher for you.

⚠️ Here are 3 BIG red flags I’d pay VERY close attention to:

1. You’re performing scenes and receiving criticism, but you’re not being TRAINED to improve.

A teacher can critique your scene every week, but if they aren’t giving you the exercises and techniques to develop your overall ability as an actor, that’s criticism, not training.

2. You’re not seeing meaningful growth in your acting, which is holding you back from becoming the extraordinary actor you’re capable of becoming with the right training.

🚨 3. Your acting teacher has never built a successful working career as an actor: How can you be confident that what you’re being taught will help you BOOK WORK if your teacher has never built a successful career themselves?

These are the kinds of red flags that can make you waste months (and thousands of dollars) on training that isn’t moving you forward.

So I created the FREE Acting Teacher Blueprint.

Inside, I’ll show you exactly what kind of training will help you BOOK WORK, so you don’t waste another dollar or another year on acting training that isn’t advancing you.

👇 Comment TEACHER below and DM me TEACHER.

I’ll send you the Blueprint FREE.

AURELLE MODEL MANAGEMENT
International New Face Casting

AURELLE Model Management is currently scouting distinctive female talent aged 18–28 for potential representation and future opportunities within the international fashion industry.

We are looking for individuals with strong presence, individuality and the confidence to bring something unique to the fashion world. We welcome applications from diverse ethnicities, cultures, body types, heights, skin tones, hair textures, facial structures and personal styles.

At AURELLE, difference is not a disadvantage. Your individuality, authenticity and personal identity are what make you memorable.

If you are interested in being considered, please send an email to:

[aurellemodel@gmail.com](mailto:aurellemodel@gmail.com)

Please include:
* Full name
* Age
* Current city and country
* Contact number
* Instagram or social-media profile
* Height
* A brief introduction about yourself
* Recent natural photographs or digitals, including a clear portrait and full-length image

Please ensure that all information submitted is accurate and that photographs are recent, clear and free from heavy filters.

Please arrange to be available for an online callback audition ONLY IF you are selected and notified via email.

All models under the age of 21 must be accompanied during the audition by a parent or legal guardian.

Submitting an application does not guarantee selection or representation. Only selected applicants will be contacted via email.

AURELLE MODEL MANAGEMENT
London | International Talent Scouting

Different is the standard.

items.text:
CASTING CALL – “ALONE” | Independent Short Film

We are casting the lead role for Alone, an independent short film set in the present day and the past.

The film follows a young man who wakes alone in a car park with no memory of how he got there, gradually trying to piece together what has happened.

Role: Male lead
Playing age: 20–30
Experience: Previous acting experience is welcome but absolutely not essential.

The role will involve some physical performance, so applicants should be comfortable with this. Further details will be provided before filming.

Filming will take place over one full day at several locations in/around North Wiltshire. The exact filming date will be agreed with the successful actor once availability has been discussed.

This is currently an unpaid independent production although lunch will be provided. [Unfortunately, we are unable to cover travel expenses.]

[The successful actor will receive a copy of the finished film and footage suitable for use in a showreel.]

To apply, please email hg.film.creations@gmail.com with the subject: Alone – Short Film Application

Please include:

- A recent headshot/photo
- Your age
- Your location
- Any relevant acting experience (although no previous experience is required)

Shortlisted applicants will be sent a short extract from the script and asked to record a brief self-tape audition.

Thank you — I look forward to hearing from you.

topComments.text: If you can't cover travel as a minimum dude you shouldn't be making a film. Actors at the very least shouldn't be out of pocket to work.

🎬 WALSALL & WEST MIDLANDS ACTORS, THIS ONE'S FOR YOU.

We’re casting for our upcoming short film ORANGUTANGO 🦧🎭

Join us for our AUDITION WORKSHOP on 25 SEPTEMBER!

Whether you’ve been acting for years, you’re just starting out, or you’ve never auditioned before, we want to meet you.

✨ 18+
🎬 No previous experience required
🎭 Opportunities to audition for roles in Orangutango
📅 25 SEPTEMBER
📍 West Midlands

🎟️ WANT TO ATTEND?

Register your place through our online form!

All you need to do is fill in the form and provide your email address.

Once you've registered, we will email you the workshop address and all the important information you need to know before attending. 📩

🔗 REGISTER HERE:

**CASTING CALL FOR INDIE MUSIC VIDEO **

Seeking: 25–40 year old WOMAN

Height: Between 5’5” and 5’10” medium to athletic build

Compensation: $150/day

Non-Union

Project: Indie Music Video

We're casting the female lead for a narrative music video exploring the emotional arc of a relationship's collapse. The character moves through the video in three registers: intimate and joyful, volatile and confrontational, and finally distant, almost spectral, as she becomes a haunting presence. This is a physically and emotionally expressive role with no dialogue. The performance carries the story through body language, presence, and a handful of key emotional beats.

Some scenes involve outdoor/wilderness terrain so comfort with hiking and outdoor shoot conditions is a plus.

Who you are:
* Comfortable with emotionally expressive, non-verbal performance (visible rage, tenderness, indifference/contempt)
* Comfortable on outdoor/wilderness terrain, including moderate hiking with light gear
* Prior acting/modeling experience preferred but not required 

If interested, send me an email to **mm.volcano.casting@gmail.com **with your self tape and head shot, height and any relevant acting/modeling experience

**Deadline for submissions: Monday, 21 September 2026**

## CAST CALL Principal Role for SAG Micro-Budget Short Film

**Project:** The Flower Knight, narrative short (fantasy, adventure, comedic)
**Location: **Seattle and Gig Harbor, WA
**Director: **Andrew Davies
**Production Dates:** October 13–18, 2026 (Incl. some outdoor and night shoots)
**Union Status: **Open to Union and Non-Union actors 
**Compensation:**
* IMDB  Credit 
* Stipend 
* Reel footage
* Meals on shoot days

**About the film:**
Years after abandoning his role as a legendary hero, a reluctant deliveryman is dragged back into his fantasy kingdom’s endless cycle of good versus evil, only to realize the true villain might not be his former nemesis, but the realm’s rigid and stifling expectations.

**Character Breakdown: **Aurora, Principal Supporting
**Age/Gender:** Female, 20s–30s. Open to all ethnicities. Must believably read as the adult daughter of the actor playing the Sun King.

**Character Profile: **Once perfectly comfortable playing the princess in someone else's heroic story, Aurora was forced to take control of her own fate. Fiercely capable, ambitious, and determined, she has spent years transforming herself into the hero the kingdom needs, whatever her father may think.

**Range:** The role spans two distinct versions of Aurora: the gentle, idealistic princess of the past and the hardened warrior-princess she has become.

**Skills Needed:** Strong physical presence, sharp comedic timing, and the ability to balance action-hero confidence with emotional vulnerability. Role involves choreographed sword combat; stage combat or sword experience is a plus, but not required.

**How to Submit:**
Please email [somevillainfilms@gmail.com](mailto:somevillainfilms@gmail.com) or send a direct message on Discord with the following:
**Subject Line: **"Casting Submission: AURORA - [Your Name]"
* Headshot 
* Resume 
* Acting reel or links to previous work (optional) 
* Current Location 
* Availability for the October 13-18 window, particularly  17 + 18

**Submission Deadline:** September 23, 2026

Audition sides will be provided upon review of submissions.

🎬 CASTING NOW: MULTIPLE SCHOOL EXTRAS WANTED 🎬
⚠️ VOLUNTEER / WORK-EXPERIENCE OPPORTUNITY

We’re looking for multiple young actors, drama students and aspiring performers who can realistically play secondary school students in an upcoming anti-bullying and inclusion awareness short film.

📅 Sunday 28th September

📍 Budget Studios Warehouse, Stretford, Manchester

As this is a community-led project with limited funding, these roles are unpaid and are intended as an opportunity to gain practical on-set experience, build confidence in front of the camera and add experience to your acting portfolio/showreel.

🎭 WE’RE LOOKING FOR:

• Multiple extras to play school pupils

• Aspiring actors wanting filming experience

• Drama or performing arts students

• People comfortable taking direction on set

• A small number of featured extras who can deliver short scripted lines to help communicate the message of the film

• Reliable and enthusiastic people who want to contribute to something meaningful

The film explores bullying, autism, SEND and inclusion, particularly the things young people may be dealing with that aren’t immediately visible.

Our message is simple:

“Before you judge the behaviour, ask what might be happening behind it.”

No professional acting experience is required.

For anyone under 18, parent or guardian consent will be required, with appropriate safeguarding arrangements in place.

📩 TO APPLY

Send a DM with:

• Name

• Age

• Recent photo/headshot

• Any acting experience, if you have any

• Confirmation that you’re available on 28th September

• A few words about why you’d like to be involved

🎥 Gain experience. Get involved on set. Help create a film with a purpose.

Please share with actors, drama students, performing arts groups and anyone looking to gain film experience in Manchester.

Szukamy dzieci o etnicznej urodzie w wieku 5-17 lat oraz osoby do poszukiwania takich osób do odgrywania scenek na nagrania w Gdańsku lub w Warszawie.

1. Czas nagrania - 1 godzina. Termin i godziny do uzgodnienia. Nagrania są od poniedziałku do piątku.

2. Lokalizacja: Warszawa lub Gdańsk.

3. Zależy nam na dużej różnorodności etnicznej dzieci.

4. Wynagrodzenie za udział dziecka: 250 zł netto (płatne w ciągu 1 dnia po zleceniu — BLIK/konto bankowe).

5. Szukamy pilnie również osoby do szukania takich dzieci o etnicznej urodzie. Wynagrodzenie za znalezienie takiego dziecka, które zostanie zaangażowane do projektu — do uzgodnienia. Prosimy o wiadomość na adres e-mail rekrutacja@agencjainfernal.pl.

W razie zainteresowania prosimy o wysłanie zgłoszenia dziecka, podając następujące informację:

1. Imię i nazwisko

2. Rok urodzenia

3. Miasto zamieszkania

4. Telefon kontaktowy do rodzica

5. Adres e-mail do rodzica

6. Wzrost

7. Na jakie miasto jest wysyłane zgłoszenie dziecka? Na Gdańsk czy Warszawę? Czy na oba miasta?

7. Minimum jedno zdjęcie

Kontakt: rekrutacja@agencjainfernal.pl

W temacie wiadomości prosimy napisać: Inteligentny dom

Wysłanie zgłoszenie jest jednoznaczne z wyrażeniem zgody na przetwarzanie danych osobowych w celu udziału w projekcie zgodnie z Rozporządzeniem Parlamentu Europejskiego i Rady (UE) 2016/679 z dnia 27 kwietnia 2016 r. w sprawie ochrony osób fizycznych w związku z przetwarzaniem danych osobowych i w sprawie swobodnego przepływu takich danych oraz uchylenia dyrektywy 95/46/WE (ogólne rozporządzenie o ochronie danych). Administratorem Twoich danych osobowych pozyskanych w procesie rekrutacyjnym jest Agencja Artystyczna INFERNAL. Podanie danych jest dobrowolne, w każdej chwili przysługuje Ci prawo do wglądu do danych, ich poprawiania lub usunięcia. Kontakt do administratora rekrutacja@agencjainfernal.pl.

items.text:
Do reklamy obiektu rekreacyjnego na **Jurze Krakowsko-Częstochowskiej** poszukujemy **6 osób** do udziału w nagraniu:

**3 kobiety i 3 mężczyzn**
**Wiek:** ok. 35–45/50 lat

Szukamy osób fotogenicznych, naturalnych i swobodnie czujących się przed kamerą.

Nagranie będzie miało charakter lifestyle’owo-biznesowy. Do odegrania będzie kilka prostych scen, bez wypowiedzi, m.in.: **spotkanie biznesowe w obiekcie, wspólne spędzanie wolnego czasu, korzystanie z atrakcji obiektu oraz wycieczka po Jurze Krakowsko-Częstochowskiej.**

**Termin:** 28.09.2026
**Miejsce:** Podlesice, woj. śląskie
**Godziny:** do ustalenia
**Wynagrodzenie:** 500 zł netto / osoba / dzień zdjęciowy

Prawdopodobnie potrzebne będą własne stylizacje – zarówno w charakterze biznesowym, jak i bardziej casualowym. Szczegóły ustalimy przed nagraniem.

**Zgłoszenia:**
Prosimy o przesłanie aktualnych zdjęć, krótkiego filmiku oraz kilku słów o sobie na adres: **[praca@goodeye.com.pl](mailto:praca@goodeye.com.pl)**

W tytule wiadomości prosimy wpisać: **„Casting biznes”**.

Zastrzegamy sobie kontakt z wybranymi osobami.

**3 kobiety i 3 mężczyzn**
**Wiek:** ok. 35–45/50 lat

Szukamy osób fotogenicznych, naturalnych i swobodnie czujących się przed kamerą.

Nagranie będzie miało charakter lifestyle’owo-biznesowy. Do odegrania będzie kilka prostych scen, bez wypowiedzi, m.in.: **spotkanie biznesowe w obiekcie, wspólne spędzanie wolnego czasu, korzystanie z atrakcji obiektu oraz wycieczka po Jurze Krakowsko-Częstochowskiej.**

**Termin:** 28.09.2026
**Miejsce:** Podlesice, woj. śląskie
**Godziny:** do ustalenia
**Wynagrodzenie:** 500 zł netto / osoba / dzień zdjęciowy

Prawdopodobnie potrzebne będą własne stylizacje – zarówno w charakterze biznesowym, jak i bardziej casualowym. Szczegóły ustalimy przed nagraniem.

**Zgłoszenia:**
Prosimy o przesłanie aktualnych zdjęć, krótkiego filmiku oraz kilku słów o sobie na adres: **[praca@goodeye.com.pl](mailto:praca@goodeye.com.pl)**

W tytule wiadomości prosimy wpisać: **„Casting biznes”**.

Zastrzegamy sobie kontakt z wybranymi osobami.

Hi everyone!

I’m Dor, a photographer who recently moved to Berlin and I’m currently looking to connect with photography studios, model/talent agencies and creative teams.

My work focuses in portraits and event photography, with a strong focus on catching emotions and show them in an esthetic, artsy way which define my unique style. I shoot with both analog and digital photography 

I’m especially interested in joining a team where I can shoot regularly, work with models/talents and contribute to ongoing productions.

My Portfolio: https://dorlevi.myportfolio.com

If you know a studio, agency, photographer or production company looking for a photographer, I’d love to hear from you.

Thanks!

✨ Beginner-friendly

🎶 Learn technique AND the songs you really want to!

💻 Convenient online lessons from home

❤️ In-person recitals in Milwaukee at least 2x per year!

Fill out our free trial lesson form and I’ll be in touch!

🎥 In diesem Reel kündigt Monika Medek das nächste KBF an. 

👉 Sei dabei beim nächsten KBF! ✨☕️ 

📍 175. Künstler*innen Business Frühstück 
🗓️ Dienstag, 22.09.2026 – 7:15 Uhr 
🏨 Hotel Zeitgeist Vienna, Sonnwendgasse 15, 1100 Wien 

💬 Vortrag: Die Vertrauensstelle vera* 
🎙️ Heidi Fuchs 
🎤 Moderation: Andreas Huber 

Wie können Belästigung und Gewalt in Kunst und Kultur verhindert werden? Welche Herausforderungen bringt die Präventionsarbeit mit sich – und welche Chancen eröffnet sie für nachhaltige gesellschaftliche Veränderung? 

Heidi Fuchs gibt Einblick in die Arbeit von vera*, der Vertrauensstelle gegen Belästigung und Gewalt in Kunst und Kultur. Sie berichtet von Erfahrungen, Herausforderungen und Chancen der Präventionsarbeit – mit besonderem Fokus auf die Schnittstellen zwischen Kunst, Kultur und gesellschaftlicher Veränderung. 

Ein Frühstück für alle, die mehr über wirksame Prävention, sichere Arbeitsbedingungen und einen verantwortungsvollen Umgang miteinander im Kunst- und Kulturbereich erfahren möchten. 

© Philipp Wagner 

📲 Mehr Infos: 
Website: www.KünstlerBusinessFrühstück.at  
Facebook: https://fb.me/e/bfEYTvFfZ

PAID OPPORTUNITY – PRESENTER / BIG PERSONALITY WANTED – LIVERPOOL, SUNDAY 13TH SEPTEMBER

We’re looking for a confident, outgoing personality to represent Bret’s Shave Cream at The Great British Barber Bash in Liverpool this Sunday.

£175 for around 4–5 hours.

This is NOT a “stand behind an exhibition table” job.

We want someone who can work the room, approach barbers, start conversations, have a laugh and create entertaining content with us.

You’ll be given challenges throughout the day, such as:

* Interview barbers around the show
* Walk up to strangers and introduce them to Bret’s
* Present barbers with our shave cream and get their reaction
* Get brutally honest opinions on camera
* Challenge people to try the product
* Ask funny and interesting questions
* Find the biggest personalities in the room
* Create some mischief and buzz around Bret’s
* Help us capture loads of genuine social-media content

You won’t be filming. We’ll have a camera person following you and capturing the interactions.

We’re not particularly bothered about qualifications or a huge following.

You might be a presenter, actor, comedian, content creator, TikToker, salesperson — or simply someone ridiculously confident who can walk into a room full of strangers and get people talking.

You don’t need to know anything about shaving or barbering. We’ll brief you and give you the challenges.

📍 Liverpool
📅 Sunday 13th September
⏱ Approx. 4–5 hours
💰 £175

Think you’d smash it?

DM @bretsdotcom with a quick 30-second video introducing yourself and tell us where you’re based.

Your mission: make Bret’s impossible to ignore.

**Title**: Clear Eyed

**Genre**: (Drama, Horror, Tragedy.)

**Logline**: A young man struggles to hold onto his sanity as the silent image of his dead, schizophrenic brother haunts him whenever the bandages covering his missing eye are off.

**Roles**

*Drew* - Male, Early 20s: A sweet but reserved young man. He tries his best to handle his problems alone, but after losing his eye in an accident, his hallucinations get out of control. Now he's struggling to hold on to his sanity.

*Alice *- Female, Late 20s: Drew’s supportive and put together older sister. She’s lost a lot of family to this mental illness and can’t lose anyone else. She’s trying her best to keep Drew safe, but is it enough?

*Justin* - Male, Early 20s The hallucination of Drew’s dead older brother. He’s ghostly pale with a bloody bruise from a noose around his neck. The shell of their brother is a silent reminder of the illness plaguing the family.

**Production Company**: Director - Holly Mathews, Writer/Producer: Theo Henderson

**Production Type**: Student Film

**Contact Information**: email - [theo.b.henderson@gmail.com](mailto:theo.b.henderson@gmail.com)

**Union Status**:  Non-Union, etc

**Audition Information**: We are closing auditions on September 25th. 

**Shooting Schedule**: October 16th-18th and October 23rd-35th

**Filming Location**: Denver

CASTING – DANCER FOR ELECTRONIC/HOUSE MUSIC VIDEO

We’re looking for a dancer with a strong individual style and great on-camera presence to lead an independent music video for a new electronic/house track, produced by Rhodium Creative.

The concept is movement-led, with one dancer at the centre of the film, shot in a raw, urban London location. Think electronic music, interesting movement, strong visuals and a bit of edge. We’re open on dance style – contemporary, modern, hip hop/street, classical or something completely different. What matters most is someone who can bring their own style and interpretation to the track.

• Male or female, 16+
• Must read as a young adult on camera
• London-based or able to travel to London
• Comfortable improvising and collaborating creatively
• Shoot likely early–mid October

This is an unpaid creative collaboration, professionally filmed and produced. You’ll receive the finished film/footage for your showreel and portfolio, with London travel expenses covered and food and refreshments on the shoot.

Interested? DM me with a recent photo, your age and a short dance reel/video.

And if someone immediately springs to mind, please send this their way.

Rowan
Rhodium Creative

🎬 THE BROS SHOW — OFFICIAL CASTING & AUDITION DAY
The Bros Show is a South London mockumentary/comedy series following Aweys, Abdi and Aiden as they get themselves into increasingly ridiculous situations around New Harbour.

We are currently looking for actors and background performers for 12 roles/character opportunities across Season 1.

🎭 THE 12 ROLES

1. 🕴️ THE BODYGUARD — CAST

A serious, intimidating character who takes his job very seriously while surrounded by the Bros’ chaos.

STATUS: ACTOR ATTACHED ✅

2. 🎤 THE DRILL AD-LIB GUY — CAST

The character who appears during the manager interview and delivers unexpected drill-style ad-libs.

STATUS: ACTOR ATTACHED ✅

3. 🛡️ SECURITY — CAST

A security character who has to deal with the Bros and whatever chaos is happening around them.

STATUS: ACTOR ATTACHED ✅

4. 👮 OFFICER DIXON

One half of the recurring police duo. A serious officer who ends up dealing with the Bros and their increasingly ridiculous situations.

STATUS: AVAILABLE

5. 👮 OFFICER MALLISON

Dixon’s partner and the other half of the recurring police duo.

STATUS: AVAILABLE

6. 💅 THE DIVA GIRL

A confident, dramatic character who believes she’s destined for something much bigger and isn’t afraid to make sure everyone knows it.

STATUS: AVAILABLE

7. 🚗 THE DIVA GIRL’S DRIVER

The driver responsible for getting the Diva Girl around and dealing with her personality along the way.

STATUS: AVAILABLE

8. 💼 THE SERIOUS BUSINESSMAN

A professional, serious businessman who enters the Bros’ chaotic world and attempts to conduct himself professionally despite everything happening around him.

STATUS: AVAILABLE

9. 🇰🇷 THE K-POP MANAGER

A character who appears during the Bros’ search for management and brings a completely different approach to the entertainment industry.

STATUS: AVAILABLE

10. 👵 EPISODE 6 — THE AUNTIES

STATUS: AVAILABLE

STATUS: AVAILABLE

STATUS: AVAILABLE

Minet Library

London

10:00 AM – 5:00 PM

🕙 10:00 AM – 1:00 PM

• Scene readings

• Improvisation

• Character work

• Comedy exercises

• Have lunch

• Prepare the remaining scenes

**CASTING CALL EXPERIMENTAL FICTION SHORT DRAMA, COPENHAGEN (UNPAID)**

We are looking for native English-speaking actors for an upcoming experimental fiction project set in Copenhagen in early October. The project is being produced in collaboration with Minehubs Studios.

The production is unpaid, but travel expenses related to the shoot will be covered, and meals and refreshments will be provided during filming.

We are currently casting the following roles:

Andrew (Male), 40–60

The VP of his father’s company. He will do almost anything to earn his father’s recognition.

Mr. Ashford / Lawyer (Male), 40–70

A clever man who is never taking anyone’s side. He never reveals more than absolutely necessary.

Sarah (Female), 40–60

Determined to make amends for the terrible things her father has done. However, she finds herself facing the consequences on her own.

Leona (Female), 60–70

She has spent her entire life waiting for the chance to take revenge on Robert by claiming the entire inheritance, and has little concern for the people who have helped him.

To apply, please send:

• A recent and recognizable photo of yourself

• Your CV and/or details of any previous acting experience, if available

• Which role you would like to be considered for

Please send applications to js@minehubsstudios.com

We look forward to hearing from you.

After our summer break Chromolume Theatre is back with the breakdown for our final show of our 2026 Season of Identity and Expression, the first fully staged production of the Sondheim/Weidman musical Road Show, directed by Joanna Syiek with musical direction by Richard Berent!  (Note: this is very much an ensemble show, with strong singer/actor/performers needed.)

As always, please submit ALL ETHNICITIES FOR ALL ROLES!

Synopsis: Road Show is a tale of dreamers, based on the true story of the Mizner Brothers, who scramble for success, identity and love at the turn of the twentieth century.

Director: Joanna Syiek

Musical Director: Richard Berent

Audition Date(s): 09/26/2026, 09/27/2026

Callback Date(s): 09/30/2026

Rehearsal Date(s): 10/05/2026, 10/12/2026 to 11/18/2026

Preview Date(s): 11/19/2026

Opening Date(s): 11/20/2026

Closing Date(s): 12/06/2026

Location: The Zephyr Theatre

Rate: $400 honorarium, $300 for Understudies

SUBMIT ELECTRONICALLY: Email headshot & resume to casting@chrtheatre.com, NO VIDEO SUBMISSIONS

SPECIAL NOTE: Auditions are by invitation only and not all submissions will be brought in for an audition. You will be asked to please prepare a 16-32 bar selection of song in the style of the show.  NO WEBBER. An Accompanist will be provided. Bring sheet music in the correct key and cut to length ideally showing the range of the character for which you are auditioning.  Non-AEA

THERE WILL BE UNDERSTUDIES CAST FOR THE ROLES OF WILSON, AND ADDISON, RESPECTIVELY WITH TWO GUARANTEED PERFORMANCES.

Addison: Male Presenting, 30-50. The levelheaded brother living in the shadows of Wilson's schemes. A visionary artist with flair and guile. Cares for his mother. Not as prone to seizing the world as his brother. Easily influenced by his older brother.  Vocal Range: G5-F3.

Wilson: Male Presenting, 30-50. Handsome and charming. Always has a good time, but also lowlife con artist involved in a series of scams. Lives his life as one big, adventurous attempt to seize opportunity. The greedy, selfish brother to Addison.  Vocal Range: A5-F3.

Hollis Bessemer: Male Presenting, 25-30. An honest businessman who rejects the family business to build his dream of an artist colony. Partners with Addison to create an extremely successful real estate business and finally a fortune of his own. Sensitive. Loves Addison. Vocal Range: G5-B3.

Mama: Female Presenting, 50-65. Mother to Addison and Wilson. Encourages her sons to follow opportunity by any means necessary. Coddles Wilson, whom she clearly favors, and ultimately loses him to his own greed. Depends on Addison to take care of her. Vocal Range: E5-G3.

Papa: Male Presenting, 55-75. Father to Addison and Wilson. On his deathbed, he tells his sons to embrace the opportunities of the new world. Proud. Nostalgic.  Vocal Range: E5-A3.

Ensemble: Male and female Presenting, 20s – 50s. All types and singing ranges. Need fantastic singing voices and dynamic personalities to play various roles in the ensemble.

[https://chrtheatre.com/auditions](https://chrtheatre.com/auditions?fbclid=IwcGRvZgVleHRuA2FlbQIxMABicmlkETFqc2FFUE1tbVg5d3RxZFN0c3J0YwZhcHBfaWQQMjIyMDM5MTc4ODIwMDg5MgABHo_sJEci2agp51x9Im1hpdYeZ20RKFfoJ_WChpIwJtaMGcmMdglgfEu96t3Y_aem_XRkbEP9vyBpxJooNnLHXdA)

🎬 LOOKING FOR PEOPLE TO BE IN AN INDEPENDENT MOVIE — 100% REMOTE / FREE
Hey everyone! My cousins and I are currently making a low-budget independent mockumentary/comedy, and we’re looking for people who would be willing to record a short TikTok/Instagram-style video for the film.

The scene is about a world famous (and loved) rapper releasing an absolutely atrocious album, and the it gets national attention. The news, critics, fans, and everyone else and their moms are reacting to it. All social media platforms are buzzing with this sudden flop.

Our scene that we need help with opens with Big Ewan (the rapper in question) dumbfounded on his couch as his feed gets flooded with people roasting the album (where you come in)

What we’re looking for:

* A 10–30 second vertical video filmed on your phone

* Basically just you reacting to / making fun of a fictional rapper’s terrible album

* No acting experience necessary whatsoever

* You can film it at home, outside, in your car, wherever

* We’ll give you a simple prompt, but you can make the reaction your own - we LOVE improv

This is unpaid, but you will be credited in the film, and you’ll get to be part of an actual independent movie we’re hoping to eventually screen publicly.

We’re looking for a bunch of different people, so literally anyone is welcome! Remember this rapper is world famous so ALL are welcome

Don’t be afraid to get creative with it! Have fun!

Information and submission at this website!

https://bigewanmovie.netlify.app/ 

If you have any questions, comment below or DM me and I’ll send you the details. 🎥

items.text:
Seeking background actors for the local indie film “Love Letters”
- Written by Brigit Dunn & Matthew Pasnik
- Directed by Brigit Dunn
Love Letters is a queer film following seniors Sam and Megan in the final months of their high school careers. Love Letters is a 20 - 30 minute coming of age short film 
about love, heartbreak, and everything in between.

IMPORTANT NOTES:
This is an unpaid, non-union film, with meals provided on set and credit in the final product.
Shooting dates will be November 5th, 6th, 8th, 9th
The film takes place in a highschool, thus all actors must be able to believably portray a 16-18 yr old (talent must 
be 18+).

Filming locations are TBD, but all locations will be local to the Buffalo area.

We are expecting background actors to be needed on set for 1-2 of the filming dates for 6-8 hour days.

Acting experience is preferred but not required.
Application deadline is 10/10/2026

APPLYING:
To apply, please send the following information to brigitfdunn@gmail.com:

Age
Availability
Photo of yourself
Previous experience (if any)

Thank you,
Brigit Dunn

NOTE: All accepted applicants will receive a response within the week following 10/10.

SEEKING ACTORS FOR STUDENT FILM
Title: Sabotage

Genre: Action Drama

Director: Annabelle Clement

Producer: Leo Callanen

Production Type: Student Short Film

🎥🎬🎞️📽️

Logline: When talented up and coming boxer Jade Mercer’s title is challenged by a close friend, the two fighters find themselves navigating personal betrayal and doping scandals in a grisly battle for dominance in their local underground tournament. 

Synopsis: Sabotage follows a pair of underground fighters who find themselves facing each other in the ring for the first time, neither of whom are happy. Jade, the current reigning champion, fears the rift that may grow between herself and her friend should she win. Maya, the

underdog, fears the embarrassment of losing to a close friend. As the match between the two

approaches, Maya is offered a mysterious performance enhancing substance by the girls’ Coach Sean. With the introduction of these drugs, the dynamic in the ring flips on its head. Maya, taking Jade down in dramatic fashion, strips her friend of the title. This defeat sends an injured Jade on a quest to rebuild herself and her reputation in hopes of reclaiming her title. One year later, she faces Maya in a match that will decide much more than the winner of the tournament.

LEAD ROLES 🩸

Jade Mercer: Early 20’s. Jade is extremely talented in the ring, the shining star of the underground, and a fan favorite. Jade works hard and gets results, always raising the bar for herself. Despite her intensity in the ring, she’s quite caring outside of it. 

Maya Mitchell: Early 20’s. Maya may not possess the same natural talent as Jade, but she’s every bit her equal when it comes to drive and commitment. Frustrated with her skill level, she’s determined to progress in the sport by any means possible. 

Coach Sean: Late 30’s. Sean is a retired professional boxer and current coach to Maya and Jade. Gruff, hypermasculine, and corrupt; Sean frequents the betting tables at competitions. 

ADDITIONAL ROLES 🎤

Emcee: High-energy, dramatic boxing announcer. Open to adults of all genders.

Tournament Employees: Young, nervous, eager. Open to young adults of all genders.

Referee: Stoic, sharp, rule-enforcer that doesn’t mind looking the other way. Open to mature adults of all genders.

Judges Panel: Mysterious, judgemental, and corrupt. Open to mature adults of all genders.

Extras: 

We are also seeking adults of all genders for our crowd scenes! Please fill out the interest form and select that you’re interested in being an extra.

Contact: peliculas.sin.leche@gmail.com

Run time: 12 minutes

Compensation: Unpaid; Crafty and meals provided.

Union status: Non-Union

Auditions: Please fill out our interest form, which you can access here (https://linktr.ee/peliculas.sin.leche), where you can also access our sides. Please submit self-tapes via our interest form. 

Please contact peliculas.sin.leche@gmail.com if you have any questions! 

Shooting schedule: We are planning to film November 7th, 8th, 14th, and 15th, exact schedules will be sent out ahead of shooting!

Location: Auraria Campus and Downtown Denver

Thanks everyone, I look forward to hearing from you! 

https://linktr.ee/peliculas.sin.leche?utm_source=linktree_profile_share&ltsid=381674df-f458-498b-858a-a9ffe333660a

ADDITIONAL ROLES 🎤

Emcee: High-energy, dramatic boxing announcer. Open to adults of all genders.

Tournament Employees: Young, nervous, eager. Open to young adults of all genders.

Referee: Stoic, sharp, rule-enforcer that doesn’t mind looking the other way. Open to mature adults of all genders.

Judges Panel: Mysterious, judgemental, and corrupt. Open to mature adults of all genders.

Extras: 

We are also seeking adults of all genders for our crowd scenes! Please fill out the interest form and select that you’re interested in being an extra.

Contact: peliculas.sin.leche@gmail.com

Run time: 12 minutes

Compensation: Unpaid; Crafty and meals provided.

Union status: Non-Union

Auditions: Please fill out our interest form, which you can access here (https://linktr.ee/peliculas.sin.leche), where you can also access our sides. Please submit self-tapes via our interest form. 

Please contact peliculas.sin.leche@gmail.com if you have any questions! 

Shooting schedule: We are planning to film November 7th, 8th, 14th, and 15th, exact schedules will be sent out ahead of shooting!

Location: Auraria Campus and Downtown Denver

Thanks everyone, I look forward to hearing from you!

🎤 **Street Interviewer Wanted – Germany**

We’re looking for someone based in a **major German city** to conduct street interviews for Lio.

You’ll approach people, ask about their **smoking/vaping habits**, let them try Lio, and capture their reactions. Lio mimics the familiar sensation and ritual of smoking/vaping without nicotine, smoke, or vapor, helping people quit while keeping the habit.

**€50/hour — approx. 3 hours per session.**

We’ll send you the product beforehand.

If the content performs well, we’d love to make this a **long-term collaboration**.

Interested? Please send me a PM

Schauspielersuche:
Für den Kurzfilm "AT : Es stand Alles im Wahlprogramm"
sind folgende Rollen zu besetzen 

- Arabisch /Türkischer Mann ca. 20 Jahre alt
-Arabisch / Türkischer Mann ca 50 - 60 Jahre alt
- Deutscher Mann ca. 27 Jahre alt
-Arabisch / Türkische Frau ca. 27 Jahre alt
- Deutscher Mann ca 45 Jahre alt
- Deutsche Frau, blond, ca 45 Jahre alt

Filminhalt :
Ein rechtradikaler Politiker sonnt sich nach einer Wahl  in seinem Erfolg.
Aber die Fassade bröckelt. Eine bittere  Politsatire. 

Aufgrund des aktuellen Bezuges sollte der Dreh schnell erfolgen, daher kann jeder Schauspieler seine Rolle am Laptop oder Smartphone selber Filmen. 
Der Film soll dann kostenfrei auf you Tube gestellt werden und jeder kann den Film sofort nutzen. Es geht darum den Film zu verbreiten, daher auch leider keine Bezahlung,  da kein Geld verdient werden kann. 
Ich hoffe es finden sich Schauspieler, die sich gegen den Rechtsradikalismus stellen und Charakter zeigen.

Ich bin Thomas Goersch,  Schauspieler und Filmregisseur www.imdb.com/name/nm1591928
Meldet Euch unter Thomas.Goersch@vodafonemail.de 
Bis dann
Thomas

Update your Selfcast profile with brand-new professional pictures!

*International Subscription: FREE

*National Subscription: DKK 299

📅 Thursday, September 24th, 2026

⏰ Between 09:30–18:00 CET

📍 Copenhagen N

📸 Each photoshoot takes approximately 20 minutes

PRICE

International Subscription

Your photoshoot is included in your subscription at no additional cost.

National Subscription

The photoshoot costs DKK 299.

Payment must be completed before the photoshoot in order to secure your time slot.

The selected pictures from the shoot will be added directly to your Selfcast profile and can be used for casting and your professional presentation on Selfcast.

Why update your Selfcast pictures?

1. Fresh pictures show producers that your profile is active and up to date.

2. Professional pictures make your profile stronger when applying for castings.

3. Producers need to be able to see what you currently look like.

4. New pictures can give your profile a fresh start if you feel your applications have become stuck.

5. A strong, professional headshot is one of the most important parts of your casting profile.

Places are limited. If we are unable to offer you a place at this photoshoot, we will do our best to offer you a place at an upcoming Selfcast photoshoot.

See you at Selfcast! 📸

Bandprobe 
zur VOCALNIGHT,
am 24.09.2026,
 in der Endstation in Buchschlag!

Gestern Abend war es soweit - 
erste und einzige Bandprobe für meine Schülerinnen.

Band: 3 Gitarristen und Drummer 

Ziel war es, sich musikalisch aufeinander einzulassen, einen gemeinsamen Weg zu erarbeiten, um sich beim Auftritt,  in der kommenden Woche, wohl und gut zu fühlen, so dass die Emotionen frei fließen können.

Let‘s play the Music !

sharedPost.text:
URGENT : recherche H/F 25/55 ans en figuration et silhouettes pour le LUNDI 05 OCTOBRE ayant déjà eu des expériences en tant que CROUPIER(E)S et quelques H/F style elites du sud/riviera/VIP/Bling-Bling tous ages, en particulier des hommes sur PARIS.
( priorité aux comédien( nes ), pas de candidature en MP et merci de VRAIMENT lire attentivement l’annonce jusqu’au bout avant de postuler 🙏🏻 )!

Bonjour à toutes et à tous,

Dans le cadre du tournage d’une mini série pour une plate-forme je recherche des H et des F entre 25 et 55( âge apparent ), ayant de vraies aptitudes de croupiers( manipulation très rapide des cartes, connaissance des règles, manipulation des jetons, vocabulaire spécifique etc… )ou éventuellement de magiciens très expérimentés pour incarner des employés d’un cercle de jeu de St Tropez en 2005.

Tournage le LUNDI 05 OCTOBRE 2026 sur PARIS 16.
Horaires prévisionnels : 06h00/15h00

Merci de ne pas postuler si vous ne faites pas de figuration, d’indiquer vos disponibilités/indisponibilités entre le 18 SEPTEMBRE et le 14 OCTOBRE.

Pour tous : pas de défraiement transport, nous cherchons des gens sur Paris ! 🙂

Rémunération : tarif syndical figuration TV cachet 98 euros bruts( base 8h + 1h de repas )+ éventuelles heures sup/heures de nuit si il y a + éventuelle majoration silhouette de 42,24 euros si vous êtes retenus en silhouette.

Je cherche également quelques profils de clients très fortunés, bling-bling, peaux tannées par le soleil pour incarner quelques clients usés qui jouent en journée. 
L’action étant censée se passer dans le SUD, véritables sudistes, italiens, vrais anglophones/allemands bienvenus pour les sons seuls.

IMPORTANT : l’action est censée se dérouler en 2005, PAS de bouches TROP siliconnées, pas de sourcils carrés et très dessinés et pas de faux ongles très longs.
Pas de tatouages trop récents visibles.
Tribaux ok.

Si vous êtes intéressé(e)s, disponibles, que vous correspondez aux critères et que vous N’AVEZ PAS D’IMPÉRATIF HORAIRE sur le ou les jours pour lesquels vous postulez, merci de me faire parvenir votre candidature à l’adresse suivante : 

Uas.casting@gmail.com

IMPORTANT merci de préciser en OBJET de votre mail le décor avec la date pour laquelle vous postulez + votre spécificité, votre âge, NOM + Prénom, mensurations :  exemple «   05 OCTOBRE, CROUPIÈRE, Sophie MARTINEZ 25 ans, 1m75, 60kg » ou «  05 OCTOBRE,  ITALIEN, Gino FAUSTO 65 ans , 1m85, 85kg, etc… 

Votre CANDIDATURE doit comprendre si possible les éléments suivants :
-Vos indisponibilités( ou disponibilités )entre le 18 SEPTEMBRE et le 14 OCTOBRE
-VOS MENSURATIONS COMPLÈTES( taille, poids, veste, haut, pantalon, chaussures ) 
-Origines ethniques 
-Couleur des yeux
-Couleur des cheveux 
- NOM et Prénom (pas de pseudonyme)
- NUMÉRO DE TÉLÉPHONE 
-Date et lieu de naissance 
-Lieu de résidence( adresse complète )
-2 à 3 photos de vous récentes( dont portrait, en pied et un selfie pris aujourd’hui, sans filtre )
-Préciser si vous avez des expériences de service, des compétences particulières quelles qu’elles soient( magicien, croupier etc etc )
-Préciser si vous avez des tatouages, des piercings, des cheveux colorés etc.. 
-Préciser, si vous le souhaitez, si vous avez eu recours à la chirurgie esthétique 
-Préciser si vous avez des tenues très chic/luxe/gala. N’hésitez pas à envoyer des photos de vos tenues si vous le pouvez !
-Préciser si vous disposez de tenues en rapport avec de futurs potentiels décors( serveurs, sécu etc … )
N’hésitez pas à joindre des photos de vous en tenues si vous avez.
-Préciser toutes les langues que vous parlez et le niveau et tout accent spécifique que vous pourriez avoir 
-Un CV et une bande démo( si vous avez )pour mon fichier et pour d’éventuelles silhouettes.
-Des images de vous en train de manipuler des cartes éventuellement pour ceux qui postulent pour les employés du casino
-N’hésitez pas à préciser si vous avez des talents particuliers : cascade, sport à haut niveau, musicien, danseur, etc etc 
-Préciser si vous êtes autonomes et par quel moyen( voiture, scooter, vélo, trottinette etc )
-Préciser si vous êtes ok pour faire du co voiturage pour les personnes disposant d’une voiture
-Préciser la marque et la couleur de votre voiture 
-Des photos de votre voiture, scooter, vélo etc pour celles et ceux qui en ont.

Par avance désolée car je ne pourrai malheureusement pas répondre à tout le monde. Je vous re contacterai dès que possible si votre profil correspond. 

Merci par avance à toutes et à tous pour vos futurs envois et belle journée ! 🙂

Anne Arovas, assistée d’Angèle Chenais

📣** NOUVEAU TOURNAGE - VIELSALM** 📣

Bonjour à toutes et tous,

Nous entamons la préparation d'un nouveau tournage, le long-métrage*** COMME UNE GRANDE*** réalisé par Adriana Da Fonseca.
Nous sommes essentiellement à la recherche de personnes sensibilisées par le sujet traité dans le film.

L'histoire nous présente Violette, une jeune femme trisomique qui vient d'emménager dans un centre. Elle découvre la liberté tout en devant faire face aux contraintes imposées par son handicap... ou par la société ?...

Nous recherchons :

**PERSONNES NEUROATYPIQUES**, porteuses de TRISOMIE ou en situation d'autres HANDICAPS INTELLECTUELS
pour jouer des résidents du foyer lors de scènes de vie, de fête ou d'activités

**PERSONNES sensibilisées au sujet abordé**
pour jouer des membres de la famille invités lors d'une fête, des éducateurs ou des membres du personnel soignant
____

**TOURNAGE DU 19 OCTOBRE AU 4 DÉCEMBRE**

**PLUSIEURS JOURS DE PRÉSENCE SOUHAITÉS**
**VIELSALM**
**60 € par jour**
____

Si vous connaissez des personnes correspondant à ces profils, n'hésitez pas à leur partager notre annonce.
Merci de postuler à l'adresse** blanche.castpro@gmail.com avec l'objet "Comme une Grande" et vos DISPONIBILITÉS**.

Merci d'envoyer également : NOM, PRÉNOM, DATE DE NAISSANCE, NUMÉRO DE TÉLÉPHONE, VILLE DE RÉSIDENCE et 2-3 PHOTOS.

Un grand merci d'avance et au plaisir de vous accueillir dans cette atmosphère calme et respectueuse,

Blanche Amphiarus-Deprée
Maxime Burton
