AUDITION: MÆND SØGES TIL MUSICAL 🎭 
Skuespillere, sangere, dansere og ensemble søges til genopsætningen af Musicalteatrets originale, anmelderroste og storsælgende thrillermusical fra 2019, “JACK THE RIPPER: THE MUSICAL”, skrevet og instrueret af Rasmus Mansachs (skaberen af bl.a. “Vi maler byen rød: The Musical” og “Jeg tror det kaldes kærlighed: The Musical”). Vil du være med i en seriøs, dramatisk, chokerende, rørende og anderledes dansk teaterproduktion, hvor man bogstaveligt talt kommer helt ud over scenekanten? Tilmeld dig den sidste ekstra-audition hos hovedstadsområdets største musicalforening nu, hvor du også kan læse alle rollebeskrivelser: musicalteatret.dk/audition

Alle køn og aldre fra 18 år og op er velkomne, og vi søger især flere tilmeldinger fra mandlige skuespillere og/eller sangere til store roller samt solister og dansere af alle køn! Samtlige pladser/roller i forestillingen er stadig åbne.

Nye auditiondatoer: Lørdag/søndag d. 26.-27. september 2026.
Der søges: Ca. 50 skuespillere, sangere og/eller dansere i alle køn og aldre fra 18 år og op (erfaring er ikke et krav) til de 14 bærende roller og ca. 30 personer til ensemblet samt dansere.
Øveperiode: 8. oktober 2026 – 1. marts 2027.
Øvested: Teaterhuset Borgen på Frederiksberg.
Forestillingsdatoer: 3.-20. marts 2027.
Spillested: Folketeatrets Store Turnéscene i København.
OBS: Det er muligt at tilmelde sig “kun” som danser eller ensemble uden sang/replikker, hvis man ikke ønsker at synge kor eller have replikker i forestillingen.
Musicalteatret er en teaterforening, og det er derfor ulønnet at medvirke på scenen.
Auditiontilmelding: musicalteatret.dk/audition

Musicalteatret præsenterer:
“JACK THE RIPPER: THE MUSICAL”
Instruktør: Rasmus Mansachs
Sanginstruktør/korleder: Johnny Jørgensen
Koreograf: Anne-Cathrine Albæk
Manuskript: Rasmus Mansachs
Originalsange: Lars Rahbek Andresen & Rasmus Mansachs

Læs mere om audition og tilmeld dig her: musicalteatret.dk/audition

sharedPost.text:
EKSTRA-AUDITION PÅ MUSICAL 🎭 
Skuespillere, sangere, dansere og ensemble søges til genopsætningen af Musicalteatrets originale, anmelderroste og storsælgende thrillermusical fra 2019, “JACK THE RIPPER: THE MUSICAL”, skrevet og instrueret af Rasmus Mansachs (skaberen af bl.a. “Vi maler byen rød: The Musical” og “Jeg tror det kaldes kærlighed: The Musical”). Vil du være med i en seriøs, dramatisk, chokerende, rørende og anderledes dansk teaterproduktion, hvor man bogstaveligt talt kommer helt ud over scenekanten? Tilmeld dig audition hos hovedstadsområdets største musicalforening nu, hvor du også kan læse alle rollebeskrivelser: musicalteatret.dk/audition

Alle køn og aldre fra 18 år og op er velkomne, og vi søger især flere tilmeldinger fra mandlige skuespillere og/eller sangere samt solister og dansere af alle køn! Samtlige pladser/roller i forestillingen er stadig åbne.

Nye auditiondato: Lørdag/søndag d. 26.-27. september 2026.
Der søges: Ca. 50 skuespillere, sangere og/eller dansere i alle køn og aldre fra 18 år og op (erfaring er ikke et krav) til de 14 bærende roller og ca. 30 personer til ensemblet samt dansere.
Øveperiode: 8. oktober 2026 – 1. marts 2027.
Øvested: Teaterhuset Borgen på Frederiksberg.
Forestillingsdatoer: 3.-20. marts 2027.
Spillested: Folketeatrets Store Turnéscene i København.
OBS: Det er muligt at tilmelde sig “kun” som danser eller ensemble uden sang/replikker, hvis man ikke ønsker at synge kor eller have replikker i forestillingen.
Musicalteatret er en teaterforening, og det er derfor ulønnet at medvirke på scenen.
Auditiontilmelding: musicalteatret.dk/audition

Musicalteatret præsenterer:
“JACK THE RIPPER: THE MUSICAL”
Instruktør: Rasmus Mansachs
Sanginstruktør/korleder: Johnny Jørgensen
Koreograf: Anne-Cathrine Albæk
Manuskript: Rasmus Mansachs
Originalsange: Lars Rahbek Andresen & Rasmus Mansachs

Læs mere om audition og tilmeld dig her: musicalteatret.dk/audition

Another Note From Me As The Moderator
Hi everyone, hope you're well 😊

Quick note - this shouldn't really need to be said as it's already one of the group rules, but I need to reiterate it as I've noticed more posts doing this:

If you are posting a casting call, please include all the necessary information to make it worth an actor's time to apply.

A decent casting call should include:

1. Synopsis: What is the project about?

2. Filming Location: Where is the shoot taking place?

3. Paid / Unpaid: Clearly state if it's paid or unpaid, and the rate if paid.

4. Roles: What roles are you casting? Include playing ages, ethnicity, accents & skills needed for role if possible or necessary 

5. Dates: When will actors be needed if cast? (Deadline date for applications, callback date if necessary, shoot dates)

6. Type of Hire: Are you looking for local talent only, or can people from other parts of the country apply?

7. Travel & Accommodation: Will this be covered or not?

8. Audition Process: Will it be self-tape, Zoom, voice-over, or in-person?

9. How to Apply: Contact details - email, link to your page, or phone number.

Please include all of this in your post. If this information is missing, it will be removed as it wastes actors' time.

Thanks for your cooperation.

Another Note From Me As The Moderator
Hi everyone, hope you're well 😊

Quick note - this shouldn't really need to be said as it's already one of the group rules, but I need to reiterate it as I've noticed more posts doing this:

If you are posting a casting call, please include all the necessary information to make it worth an actor's time to apply.

A decent casting call should include:

1. Synopsis: What is the project about?

2. Filming Location: Where is the shoot taking place?

3. Paid / Unpaid: Clearly state if it's paid or unpaid, and the rate if paid.

4. Roles: What roles are you casting? Include playing ages, ethnicity, accents & skills needed for role if possible or necessary 

5. Dates: When will actors be needed if cast? (Deadline date for applications, callback date if necessary, shoot dates)

6. Type of Hire: Are you looking for local talent only, or can people from other parts of the country apply?

7. Travel & Accommodation: Will this be covered or not?

8. Audition Process: Will it be self-tape, Zoom, voice-over, or in-person?

9. How to Apply: Contact details - email, link to your page, or phone number.

Please include all of this in your post. If this information is missing, it will be removed as it wastes actors' time.

Thanks for your cooperation.

CASTING EXTRAS FOR SENIOR THESIS SHORT FILM ‼️‼️‼️

Hello, my name is Elliot Harrington and I am the producer of the upcoming short film called “Sponsored By”. It is about a divorced father who takes on coaching a Little League baseball team in hopes to impress his boss, get a promotion, and be invited to an exclusive BBQ.

Looking for:
- Individuals who read as 4-7 years of age (willing to accept submissions from individuals a few years older than 7)

Shooting Dates:
- September 26th: 10 AM-4 PM
- September 27th: 8 AM-2 PM
- October 3rd: 2 PM-8 PM
- October 4th: 10 AM-4 PM
- October 10th: 2 PM-8 PM 

Shooting Location: Loveland, CO

If you can make it to all these dates, congrats; you are a part of the home baseball team and have the opportunity for lines and more screen time.

If you can’t make it to all the dates and only some, congrats; you are a part of one of the away teams with no lines and less screen time.

Extras are unpaid, but will receive IMDb credit. All minors must have a parent with them present on set 24/7. We need adult extras as well, so instead of parents just sitting around, they have the opportunity to be in the bleachers, cheering on the team.

If you are interested, or know anyone who is interested, please reach out to me with your availability and your headshot. You can message me here or email me @ elliot.m.harrington@gmail.com

Thank you!

Short Film Casting Call!

Title- Roommates 

Logline- A musician riddled with self doubt is more focused on appeasing her overly critical roommate than she is on writing a new song.

**We have the rest of the cast filled except for the two roles posted here. Here is the breakdown for the characters. **

**Jenna (20-28) can be female or non binary- Jenna is Eleanor’s (main character) long time girlfriend who uses her background in psychology to help Eleanor realize how much her anxiety is controlling her. She is Eleanor’s anchor in a storm. Her style is the friendly barista at a hole in the wall coffee shop that you feel like you can open up to even if you just met. **

**Eleanor's Brother (mid to late 20's) can be male, non binary, or trans- The opposite of Eleanor with him having what society calls a “normal job”. He is happy with the life he is making for himself and wants Eleanor to not compare herself to him. He is also quite the gamer wearing his achievements in his online fantasy games like a badge of honor. Enjoys online fantasy gaming, DND style gaming, and LARPING. (Think the male version of Charlie Bradbury from Supernatural).**

**Production is aiming to film in January. **

**Production type- Non union **

**Compensation- TBD determined by funding, meals, I**MDB Credit 

Auditions will close on October 3rd 

Additional information- If cast you must be willing to sign an NDA. This is per the request of myself and the exsecutive producer  as well as our sponsors for the film.

NOW CASTING — Vancouver, BC

Project: "What Training Does To Your Body (Ages 1–100)"

For: Jeremy Ethier's YouTube channel (7.9M subscribers)

We're casting real people across a wide age range for a video comparing trained lifters vs. untrained beginner people across a lifetime — real body composition and performance testing, not just talk.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

• Ages 10–13 (male, parent/guardian approval required)

• Ages 30–35 (trained & untrained, any gender)

• Ages 50–59 (all fitness levels — including health-journey stories)

• Ages 70–79 (lifelong lifters and total beginners alike)

• Ages 95–100 (active seniors — message me directly about this one)

📍 Filming in Vancouver, BC

💰 Not a paid role, but we cover a small honorarium/gift, your travel, and all medical scan/testing fees

📋 Process: short intake questionnaire → screening → scheduling

👉 Apply here: forms.gle/5vW3rmRmpeeSMqrJ7

Channel: youtube.com/@JeremyEthier

**Casting Call - Paid, Non-Union 4 day shoot**

**Project:** Tourism Fall Video Shoot

**Details: **Paid 4 day shoot in the Okanagan, 13th-16th Oct with paid travel day either side

**Day rate:** $700-$1100 depending on experience

**Role: **We’re casting two people to play a couple in their 50s travelling for a relaxed, premium weekend exploring the Okanagan Valley. This will be a 3-4 minute video for youtube and social media. Welcoming real life couples, friends, or individuals we can pair! 

This will mostly be unscripted with conversation prompts over meals, wine tastings, spa visits etc, so we are looking for individuals to spark off each other, deliver good anecdotes, make observations and have occasional moments of sincerity.  Looking for people who:
* Curious about food, wine, travel and the people they meet
* Enjoy an active lifestyle
* Comfortable cycling recreationally and a cold plunge
* Relaxed and a natural charisma on camera
* Take pride in their style

Previous acting experience is useful but not essential if the personalities are right. Welcoming comedic performers, improvisers, presenters, writers, athletes, foodies or people with interesting life experience could all be appropriate. Welcome submissions from all ethnicities. 

This will be a fun one, with tonal references of the 'The Trip'.

For more information email your headshot and resume to georgia@weareskeletoncrew.ca

PAID CASTING: Female Lead/Co Star | Music Video | Toronto / GTA
Casting a female lead (playing age 19–27) for a cinematic pop/R&B music video filming in the GTA one day between Sept 26-Oct 5 (exact date TBD).

Concept: A darkly playful relationship visual centered around a chess game, exploring gaslighting, hypocrisy and double standards. The female character is confident and self-assured and genuinely believes she is being reasonable, even as the male lead becomes increasingly frustrated. Looking for someone who can communicate disbelief, defensiveness, irritation and “you’re overreacting” energy through subtle facial expressions and eye contact.

• Rate: $150 CAD flat

• Time: Approx. 3–4 hours

• Location: GTA, exact location TBD

• Union: Non-union

• Physicality: No kissing, sexual content or romantic physicality required.

Acting/on-camera experience is preferred but newer performers with strong camera presence are welcome.

To apply: DM me here or on IG @thelinkstrummer with your name, age/playing age, current photos, general GTA location, and any acting reel/on-camera footage if available. Thanks!

**NORWEGIAN AURA CASTING AUDITIONS**
**NON-UNION**

Norwegian Cruise Line is currently seeking **Production Dancers, Singers, Specialty Vocalists, and Aerialists** for original mainstage productions debuting aboard the newest vessel, the Norwegian AURA.

The AURA will feature a brand-new concert/Las Vegas residency-style production centered around the musical legacy of Whitney Houston, following in the footsteps of *Revolution: A Celebration of Prince* aboard Norwegian AQUA and *Elton: A Celebration of Elton John* aboard Norwegian LUNA. Cast members may also participate in and/or cover other entertainment offerings including Welcome Aboard Shows, nightclub events, parties, and other experiences.

PRODUCTION DANCERS — LOS ANGELES

**Saturday, September 19, 2026**
**OPEN CALL — NO PRE-REGISTRATION REQUIRED**

**Mihran K. Studios**
135 N Victory Blvd
Burbank, CA 91502

Sign-in: **9:30 AM**
Audition begins: **10:00 AM**

Talent will be seen in the order in which they arrive. **Callbacks will be held the same afternoon.**

Female-identifying performers should be prepared to dance in both **heels and flats**. Male-identifying dancers should bring **sneakers and jazz shoes**. Please bring a hard copy headshot and resume. All dancers should wear form-fitting dance attire and be prepared to learn multiple combinations.

Seeking athletic, dynamic, versatile dancers with a strong technical foundation and training in a wide range of styles spanning commercial jazz, contemporary, hip-hop, and more. The ability to partner and lift or be lifted is a must. Strong performance quality, audience engagement, and storytelling are essential. Tumbling/acro is a plus, and certain dancers will be trained in various aerial skills during the rehearsal process. **All ethnicities. Singing is not required. Must be 18+.**

**DANCERS: $1,000/week ($4,350/month) onboard**

**Full Los Angeles audition information:**
[https://nclhcreativestudios.com/2026_auditions/losangeles_aura_sept2026.html](https://nclhcreativestudios.com/2026_auditions/losangeles_aura_sept2026.html)

SINGERS & SPECIALTY VOCALISTS — LOS ANGELES

**Sunday, September 20, 2026**
**BY APPOINTMENT ONLY **

Seeking Production Singers and Specialty Vocalists. Specialty Vocalists should be seasoned vocalist entertainers with strong pop, gospel and R&B backgrounds, while Production Singers should be charismatic performers with strong contemporary pop, rock and R&B skills, tight harmonies, and the ability to move or dance well.

**Specialty Vocalists: $1,730/week ($7,500/month)**
**Singers: $1,200/week ($5,200/month)**

To be considered for an appointment, submit through Breakdown Services, Actors Access, or the audition link below. Selected applicants will receive audition location, time, and additional details by email.

**Full Los Angeles audition information & submission:**
[https://nclhcreativestudios.com/2026_auditions/losangeles_aura_sept2026.html](https://nclhcreativestudios.com/2026_auditions/losangeles_aura_sept2026.html)

AERIALISTS — LAS VEGAS

**Tuesday, September 22, 2026**
**BY INVITATION ONLY **

Seeking athletic, dynamic, versatile gymnasts/acrobats and aerial artists with expertise in skills including **Silks, Straps, Bungee, Cube, Hand Balancing, and Acro/tumbling**. Strong upper-body strength and physical presence are required. Dance training and an understanding of body lines and positions are a major plus. The ability to engage an audience, embody a character, and tell a story is essential.

**Aerialists: $1,350/week ($5,850/month) onboard**

Pre-registration is required. To be considered for an appointment, submit through the link below. Selected applicants will receive the audition location, time, and additional details by email. **Male and female identifying. All ethnicities. Must be 18+.**

**Full Las Vegas audition information & submission:**
[https://nclhcreativestudios.com/2026_auditions/lasvegas_aura_sept2026.html](https://nclhcreativestudios.com/2026_auditions/lasvegas_aura_sept2026.html)

Burbank, CA 91502

Sign-in: **9:30 AM**
Audition begins: **10:00 AM**

Talent will be seen in the order in which they arrive. **Callbacks will be held the same afternoon.**

Female-identifying performers should be prepared to dance in both **heels and flats**. Male-identifying dancers should bring **sneakers and jazz shoes**. Please bring a hard copy headshot and resume. All dancers should wear form-fitting dance attire and be prepared to learn multiple combinations.

Seeking athletic, dynamic, versatile dancers with a strong technical foundation and training in a wide range of styles spanning commercial jazz, contemporary, hip-hop, and more. The ability to partner and lift or be lifted is a must. Strong performance quality, audience engagement, and storytelling are essential. Tumbling/acro is a plus, and certain dancers will be trained in various aerial skills during the rehearsal process. **All ethnicities. Singing is not required. Must be 18+.**

**DANCERS: $1,000/week ($4,350/month) onboard**

**Full Los Angeles audition information:**
[https://nclhcreativestudios.com/2026_auditions/losangeles_aura_sept2026.html](https://nclhcreativestudios.com/2026_auditions/losangeles_aura_sept2026.html)

SINGERS & SPECIALTY VOCALISTS — LOS ANGELES

**Sunday, September 20, 2026**
**BY APPOINTMENT ONLY **

Seeking Production Singers and Specialty Vocalists. Specialty Vocalists should be seasoned vocalist entertainers with strong pop, gospel and R&B backgrounds, while Production Singers should be charismatic performers with strong contemporary pop, rock and R&B skills, tight harmonies, and the ability to move or dance well.

**Specialty Vocalists: $1,730/week ($7,500/month)**
**Singers: $1,200/week ($5,200/month)**

To be considered for an appointment, submit through Breakdown Services, Actors Access, or the audition link below. Selected applicants will receive audition location, time, and additional details by email.

**Full Los Angeles audition information & submission:**
[https://nclhcreativestudios.com/2026_auditions/losangeles_aura_sept2026.html](https://nclhcreativestudios.com/2026_auditions/losangeles_aura_sept2026.html)

AERIALISTS — LAS VEGAS

**Tuesday, September 22, 2026**
**BY INVITATION ONLY **

Seeking athletic, dynamic, versatile gymnasts/acrobats and aerial artists with expertise in skills including **Silks, Straps, Bungee, Cube, Hand Balancing, and Acro/tumbling**. Strong upper-body strength and physical presence are required. Dance training and an understanding of body lines and positions are a major plus. The ability to engage an audience, embody a character, and tell a story is essential.

**Aerialists: $1,350/week ($5,850/month) onboard**

Pre-registration is required. To be considered for an appointment, submit through the link below. Selected applicants will receive the audition location, time, and additional details by email. **Male and female identifying. All ethnicities. Must be 18+.**

**Full Las Vegas audition information & submission:**
[https://nclhcreativestudios.com/2026_auditions/lasvegas_aura_sept2026.html](https://nclhcreativestudios.com/2026_auditions/lasvegas_aura_sept2026.html)

items.text:
Monstrous Reflections my first feature film is now in pre-production with the aim to start filming early 2027. If you like truly dark, British gritty thrillers based in the extremes of social realism then this is the film for you. I will be aiming to start the casting process at the end of October for those who want to portray a role in this film. 

I am not certain at this time whether roles will be paid or a profit percentage offered instead. This will all come down to final funding. Either way, this film will be made regardless of final funds, teamwork makes the dream work and profits will be shared equally with everyone involved. 

Anyone who is interested please first check out the short concept film that heavily influences this feature. You will get an idea of what direction this feature film is going in and the style. 

During the casting process, actors will be asked about the short concept film, what they feel they could bring to the roles in this style of dark, psychological gritty thriller. 

You can check it out on YouTube now for free. I'll post a link in the comments below 👇.

https://youtu.be/fa0xm0LcA08?is=Qr7bUuR8gzKmchUF
